check_rule: Dynamic average formula over score column
validation_rule: Summary metric should use a dynamic formula rather than a hardcoded number so row edits update totals

check_rule: Safe division when denominator is zero or blank
validation_rule: Division formula must guard against zero or empty denominators instead of exposing #DIV/0!

check_rule: Valid referenced range with no broken links
validation_rule: Formulas must not reference deleted or shifted ranges producing #REF!

check_rule: Trimmed canonical label with consistent casing
validation_rule: Trailing whitespace on category labels breaks exact-match filters and splits grouped counts
Inconsistent capitalization across status labels fragments pivot/group summaries
Duplicate record IDs create ambiguity during joins

check_rule: Non-empty identifier on every data row
validation_rule: Missing record IDs prevent reliable row tracking across sheets and exports

check_rule: Sum of status counts equals total evaluated rows
validation_rule: Status breakdown counts must reconcile with total row count to avoid dropped or double-counted rows

check_rule: Non-empty rationale on failed or edge-case rows
validation_rule: Failed or flagged rows require a non-empty finding/remediation note before sign-off

check_rule: Score within valid rubric bounds (1 to 5)
column9: Out-of-range scores outside the rubric scale must be caught by validation rules
